pages.title: Rapunzel Trying on the Royal Tiara in Front of a Mirror Coloring Page
pages.description: Rapunzel tries on a royal tiara before a mirror in this printable coloring page, raising both hands to adjust the jewels above her long hair. Her reflection shows a lace-up bodice and striped puffed sleeves, with the oval mirror's curling frame adding detail to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Princess Rapunzel in Dragon Kingdom Coloring Page
pages.description: Rapunzel stands in a dragon kingdom on this printable coloring page, with a flower-decorated braid looping across her long dress and a smiling dragon behind her. Swirling hem patterns add smaller details to the coloring sheet, surrounded by rocks, mountains, stars, and a distant castle.

pages.title: Disney Princess Rapunzel Coloring Page Free Printable for Kids
Princess Rapunzel Running In Flower Field Coloring Page
pages.description: Rapunzel runs through a flower field in this printable coloring page, her long loose hair streaming behind her beneath a large sun and flying birds. A laced bodice, sweeping skirt, and scalloped hem distinguish her outfit, while oversized blossoms fill the coloring sheet's foreground.

pages.title: Princess Rapunzel Exploring In Canyon Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Rapunzel exploring a canyon, reaching toward a layered rock wall with her long braid trailing far behind her dress. Tall cliffs frame the figure, while small cacti and an arched bridge add distinct background shapes to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Princess Rapunzel Balancing In Floating Island Coloring Page
pages.description: Rapunzel balances on a floating island in this printable coloring page, lifting her skirt as her flower-decorated braid loops around her bare feet. Smaller floating rocks, birds, a large sun, and curled clouds surround her, with flowers and a miniature bridge adding detail to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Princess Rapunzel Observing On Street Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Rapunzel looking down at a village street from an arched window, her long braid hanging over the building's outer wall. Two children stand below among cobblestones and houses, giving the coloring sheet a tall tower scene with broad walls and smaller architectural details.

pages.title: Princess Rapunzel Posing In Game World Coloring Page
pages.description: Rapunzel poses in a game world on this printable coloring page, wearing a tiara and a flower-patterned dress while holding out a strand of hair. Spotted mushrooms grow on floating platforms around her, with winding paths and cloud-borne blocks adding distinctive shapes to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Princess Rapunzel Walking By Water Coloring Page
pages.description: Rapunzel walks by the water in this printable coloring page, stepping barefoot among small ripples with her long braid hanging beside her simple flowing gown. Large curling waves fill the foreground, while flowers, low hills, and a distant castle provide the coloring sheet's surrounding landscape.

pages.title: Princess Rapunzel Pointing In Glowing Zone Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Rapunzel pointing toward a large outlined burst in a glowing zone, with her loose hair sweeping behind her full-length dress. A scalloped neckline and cuffs add small details to the figure, while a vine-covered tower window appears beside the coloring sheet's open background.

pages.title: Princess Rapunzel Walking Slowly In Treasure Room Coloring Page
pages.description: Rapunzel walks slowly through a treasure room in this printable coloring page, wearing a patterned gown with flowers threaded through her long trailing braid. Open chests, crowns, coins, and beaded necklaces surround her, with hanging banners and tiled flooring completing the detailed treasure coloring sheet.

pages.title: Princess Rapunzel Exploring In Desert Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Rapunzel exploring a desert, her long braid coiled on the sand beside a gown with striped sleeves and scalloped trim. Cacti flank the figure, while dunes, a palm-lined pool, and a sun with straight rays frame the desert coloring sheet.

pages.title: Princess Rapunzel Exploring In Ocean Coloring Page
pages.description: Rapunzel explores the ocean in this printable coloring page, holding her hand beneath a small striped fish while a turtle swims beside her flowing dress. Her long braid floats outward among bubbles, with starfish, branching coral, and tube-shaped sea plants completing the underwater coloring sheet.

pages.title: Princess Rapunzel Resting In Cave Coloring Page
pages.description: Rapunzel rests inside a cave on this printable coloring page, lying on a ledge with her chin supported by one hand and her braid falling forward. Hanging crystals frame the opening, while flowers, small stones, and long curling hair ends add details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Princess Rapunzel Looking Around in Bonus Room Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Rapunzel looking around a bonus room, standing barefoot beside a blank easel with one hand raised and flowers throughout her hair. Long strands spread across the floor, while bookshelves, an arched window, and an oval rug complete the interior coloring sheet.
